findings.issue: The app ships zero tests despite ~700 lines of intricate data-transformation logic (filtering, pagination, sorting, dedup, URL state) that is only guarded by the acceptance suite.
findings.suggestion: Add a minimal Vitest suite for app/src/lib/util.js and app/src/lib/data.js against a stubbed fetch (the fixture API shape), covering filtering, pagination edges, method ordering, and missing-value sorting.

findings.issue: apiFetch caches the promise for failed/ non-OK requests, so a transient error or 404 is stored as null for the lifetime of the process and every caller then renders a 404 page.
findings.suggestion: Only cache successful responses; delete the cache entry (or cache an error marker with TTL) when fetch rejects or res.ok is false.

findings.issue: EvoNode dereferences props.node.name unconditionally, but getPokemonPage (data.js:232) returns evolution: null when the evolution-chain fetch fails — an API hiccup crashes the whole Pokémon page.
findings.suggestion: Guard the Evolution section with <Show when={d().evolution}> (and/or fall back to a single-node chain) and cover it with an error-path test.

findings.issue: The search input's value is bound to the server-confirmed d().q, so keystrokes typed while the debounced navigation/refetch is in flight can be clobbered when the URL catches up — a race no current test would catch.
findings.suggestion: Keep the raw input in a local signal and sync from the URL only on external changes, and add a behavioural test that types quickly and asserts results for the final input.

findings.issue: Move grouping pushes one row per version_group_details entry, so a move listed twice for the same version group yields duplicate table rows; nothing would catch this or a regression in method ordering/level sorting.
findings.suggestion: Dedupe rows per (move, level) and unit-test the grouping and ordering of byMethod/methodEntries.

findings.issue: The debounce timer is never cleared on unmount, so a pending updateParams can navigate after the user has left the home page.
findings.suggestion: Clear searchTimer in onCleanup and cover filter interaction ordering with a test.

findings.issue: Page silently clamps to totalPages when page is out of range, diverging URL (?page=999) from rendered state — a reasonable choice, but untested behaviour someone could change without noticing.
findings.suggestion: Pin the clamp/redirect behaviour with a test for out-of-range page values.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own: no runner, no test script, zero test files, while all its substantial logic — filtering, 48-per-page pagination, alternate-form exclusion, move-table grouping and sorting, and URL state — lives in one untested data layer. The acceptance suite is currently the only guard, so any refactor of app/src/lib/data.js or the URL-sync in routes/index.jsx can silently regress behaviour, including a real latent crash in the Evolution section and a failure-caching bug in the API client. The data layer is cleanly factored for testability (pure helpers, query functions), which makes the absence of even a small unit suite the central omission of this change.
